name: Ignatius Ivanov
source:
Ignatius is a studious young man who is specifically interested in the sciences. Clearly, all his hard work pays off as he does extremely well in school.

Ignatius attends the same school as Lucia and lives right next door to her. Though not quite close, he and Lucia are on pretty good terms and get along pretty well due to their shared interest: academics.

After his parents' separation, Ignatius now lives with his mother, while his older brother, Yuri, lives with their father. Ignatius seems to feel strong hatred towards his own brother, believing him to be the reason as to why their parents decided to live separate lives.
